title: Rest
summary: (1.) Gr. katapausis, equivalent to the Hebrew word noah (Heb. 4:1).

inlines.v: (1.) Gr. katapausis, equivalent to the Hebrew word noah (Heb. 4:1).
(4.) Gr. sabbatismos, a Sabbath rest, a rest from all work (Heb. 4:9; R.V., "sabbath"), a rest like that of God when he had finished the work of creation.
